notes.md: - **AP Startup Policy:** Andhra Pradesh was the **first State** to launch an **Innovation and Startup Policy (2014-2020)**. **APIS**, headed by a **CEO** under the **ITE&C Department**, is the State's **nodal agency** for start-up initiatives.

- **Six components:** (1) deep-sea mining technologies and **manned submersible**; (2) **ocean climate change advisory services**; (3) deep-sea **biodiversity** exploration and conservation; (4) **deep ocean survey** and exploration; (5) **energy and freshwater from the ocean** (OTEC-powered offshore desalination); (6) **Advanced Marine Station for Ocean Biology**.
- **Chandra X-ray Observatory:** NASA's X-ray telescope, launched **23 July 1999**, is named after **S. Chandrasekhar**.
